devdoc.details: Users must approve this contract to spend their assets before calling deposit/mint functions The contract automatically resolves the correct vault for each asset type and handles all necessary approvals and transfers on behalf of users.

AssetMismatch().details: Thrown when the vault's asset doesn't match the provided asset

MintAmountMismatch().details: Thrown when the actual mint amount doesn't match the expected amount

NoVaultForAsset().details: Thrown when no vault exists for the specified asset

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

ZeroAssets().details: Thrown when zero assets are specified for deposit

ZeroReceiver().details: Thrown when the receiver address is zero

ZeroShares().details: Thrown when zero shares are specified for minting

constructor.details: Initializes the GenericDepositor with required contract references

params._bridgeCoordinator: The bridge coordinator for cross-chain operations

deposit(address,address,uint256).details: Automatically resolves the correct vault for the given asset

params.asset: The ERC20 token to deposit (USDC, USDT, or USDS)
params.assets: The amount of assets to deposit
params.whitelabel: The whitelabeled unit token address, or address(0) for standard units

returns.shares: The number of shares minted to the caller

depositAndBridge(address,uint256,uint16,.details: Combines deposit and bridge operations in a single transaction

params.asset: The ERC20 token to deposit (USDC, USDT, or USDS)
params.assets: The amount of assets to deposit
params.bridgeParams: Additional parameters required by the bridge
params.bridgeType: The type of bridge to use
params.remoteRecipient: The recipient address on the destination chain (as bytes32)

returns.messageId: The bridge message ID for tracking

depositAndPredeposit(address,uint256,byt.details: Predeposited shares can be bridged later via the bridge coordinator

params.asset: The ERC20 token to deposit (USDC, USDT, or USDS)
params.assets: The amount of assets to deposit
params.chainNickname: A human-readable identifier for the destination chain
params.remoteRecipient: The recipient address on the destination chain (as bytes32)

returns.shares: The number of shares minted and predeposited

mint(address,address,uint256).details: Calculates the required asset amount using previewMint and deposits that amount

params.asset: The ERC20 token to deposit (USDC, USDT, or USDS)

params.whitelabel: The whitelabeled unit token address, or address(0) for standard units

returns.assets: The amount of assets that were deposited

mintAndBridge(address,uint256,uint16,uin.details: Combines mint and bridge operations in a single transaction

params.asset: The ERC20 token to deposit (USDC, USDT, or USDS)
params.bridgeParams: Additional parameters required by the bridge
params.bridgeType: The type of bridge to use
params.remoteRecipient: The recipient address on the destination chain (as bytes32)
params.shares: The exact number of shares to mint
params.whitelabel: The whitelabeled unit token address on the destination chain

returns.assets: The amount of assets that were deposited
returns.messageId: The bridge message ID for tracking

params.shares: The exact number of shares to mint

returns.assets: The amount of assets that were deposited
